title: The War Against Birds

characters.name: Major Meredith
characters.locked_description: Major Meredith, a lean Australian artillery officer of about forty, a sunburnt narrow face, a trim moustache, a khaki tunic with a leather Sam Browne belt, riding breeches and puttees, a khaki slouch hat with one brim pinned up

characters.name: The two gunners
characters.locked_description: two young Australian artillery gunners in their twenties, sunburnt faces, khaki shirts with rolled sleeves, dusty breeches and puttees, khaki slouch hats with one brim pinned up, canvas webbing belts

characters.name: The veteran farmers
characters.locked_description: veteran wheat farmers of Western Australia, weathered men in their forties, sun-creased faces, collarless cotton work shirts with rolled sleeves, braces, battered brown felt hats, dusty boots, a few old khaki army tunics

characters.name: Sir George Pearce
characters.locked_description: Sir George Pearce, Australia’s Minister of Defence, a stout man in his early sixties, thinning white hair, a clipped white moustache, a dark three-piece suit with a high white collar and a watch chain

characters.name: The emus
characters.locked_description: wild emus, tall flightless birds nearly as tall as a man, shaggy drooping grey-brown feathers, a long bare blue-grey neck, a small head with a bright dark eye, long powerful pale legs

locations.name: The wheatbelt
locations.locked_description: the wheatbelt of Western Australia, flat paddocks of dry golden wheat on red earth, grey wire-and-post fences, scattered low mallee scrub and a few pale gum trees, a vast open horizon

locations.name: The Campion dam
locations.locked_description: a small farm dam in the wheatbelt, a raised bank of raw red earth around a shallow muddy pool, dry saltbush and low mallee scrub along the bank, one dead white gum stump

locations.name: The House of Representatives
locations.locked_description: the House of Representatives chamber of 1932, curved rows of green leather benches, dark polished timber panelling, a high Speaker’s chair, a public gallery rail above and tall arched windows

locations.name: The minister’s office
locations.locked_description: a government minister’s office of 1932, dark timber panelling, a broad leather-topped desk, a large wall map of Australia, a tall window with white net curtains and a brass desk lamp

key_props.name: The Lewis gun
key_props.locked_description: a First World War Lewis machine gun on a folding bipod, a long barrel inside a perforated cooling jacket, a flat round pan magazine on top, a wooden stock and a pistol grip

key_props.name: The army truck
key_props.locked_description: a 1930s Australian army lorry, an open flat tray with low timber sides, a high boxy bonnet, big spoked wheels, a canvas-roofed cab, olive-khaki paint scuffed with red dust

key_props.name: The bounty ledger
key_props.locked_description: a heavy bound ledger on a scarred timber counter, thick cream pages ruled in columns and filled with tick marks, a rubber stamp and an inkpad beside it, a pile of small paper claim slips

notes: Samostalna epizoda, ideja #10 u docs/ideas.md, prva australijska na kanalu (region Australia, epoha Modern Era, 1932). Zapadna Australija, pojas psenice, Campion. Izvori su iskljucivo sekundarni (Wikipedia Emu War i tri lokalne/popularne strane); Trove, Hansard i Meredithov izvestaj nisu otvoreni, zapisano u research.md i ideas.md. Narracija snimljena i poravnata (timing.json, 210.913s, 42 recenice). 31 beat, 32 shota (28 klipova + 4 slike), beat mapa odobrena unapred, lockovi i storyboard upisani; vidi notes.md (osa ekrana, rezim, sta ostaje) i alternatives.md (Plan B/C za 12, 13, 19). Rezim shota je mesan, birano iz kadra, ne iz kredita. Tacnost perioda: 1932, vojni Lewis mitraljezi iz Prvog svetskog rata (okrugli sarzer na vrhu), australijske uniforme 1930-ih (kaki, sesir sa podignutim obodom), kamion sa otvorenim sandukom, farmeri u radnim kosuljama i sesirima, pejzaz: suva zlatna psenica, ograde, grmlje (mallee), crvena zemlja. Emui: realna velicina i izgled (do 1.9 m visine), nikako crtani; humor ide iz kompozicije i mirnoce, ne iz karikature. Ne crtati krv i lesine; ubijeni emui nisu u kadru, posledica je prazan pasnjak i pero. Ne prikazivati istorijske osobe kao poznata lica: Meredith i Pearce su opisani, Beyer nije u kadru. Meredithov citat ('military division with the bullet-carrying capacity') potice iz novina iz 1953, skripta kaze 'is quoted as saying'. Brojke se ne slazu (50 do 500 ubijenih do 8. novembra; 986 tvrdi Meredith) i prikazuju se kao raspon, ne kao cinjenica. 'Birds won' je kuka iz ideas.md prenesena doslovno; skripta joj odgovara pitanjem 'So who won?'. Protagonists za publish.md se upisuju pre naslova: naslov ne imenuje nikog (emui i vojnici grupno) ili imenuje sve glavne (Meredith, Pearce), nikad jednog + deo.
